results.scope: Verifies that 5-arm pentad dry-run executes across all 5 arms cleanly and populates runs dictionary.
Verifies that generated markdown report explicitly contains sections and rows for all 5 arms.
Verifies that Arm A -> Native, Arm B -> Cand3, Arm C -> Cand4.2 Always-On, Arm D -> Cand4.2 Adaptive, Arm E -> Cand5 Optimized.
Verifies that Candidate 5 binary cryptographic SHA-256 matches E4E5321624817CF20B6D300BF88897BFC1673F52308D75B21AEC3D143269AE44 exactly.
Verifies that orchestrator raises SafetyViolationError if Candidate 5 binary path does not exist.
Verifies that orchestrator rejects execution if any arm from the 5-arm pentad specification is missing from order.
Verifies that orchestrator rejects duplicate arms in execution order.
Verifies that requesting an unregistered candidate version raises SafetyViolationError.
Verifies rejection of invalid arm names not conforming to pentad specification.
Verifies rejection of altered, dirty, or corrupted benchmark task fixtures.
Verifies immediate pre-dispatch abort if candidate binary hash differs by even 1 bit from the ledger.
Verifies acceptance validator rejects runs with missing or invalid telemetry.
Verifies that duplicate run IDs or telemetry records trigger validation failure.
Verifies that comparative analysis invalidates savings claims when an arm is incomplete.
Verifies that exceeding per-arm token ceiling overrides status to TOKEN_CEILING_BREACHED.
Verifies that global cumulative token limit triggers immediate abort of subsequent arms.
Verifies that strict execution policy halts on first arm failure and skips remaining arms.
Verifies identical PRNG seed produces identical arm execution permutation across runs.
Verifies that skipped downstream arms are correctly populated with SKIPPED status and error_message explanation.
Verifies comparative analysis returns MUTUAL_ACCEPTANCE_FAILURE / INCOMPLETE when any arm fails acceptance.
